page_title: ATM 1-1 VIL | Atletico Madrid v Villarreal 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Villarreal have a corner.

90+3' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Now Villarreal have a corner.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Alex Baena is given a rest as he is replaced by Pau Cabanes (Villarreal).
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Alex Baena (Villarreal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

86' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is first to the cross from Rodrigo de Paul, but fires his header just past the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
85' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

85' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
84' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

84' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Junior Reis easily deals with the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
83' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
81' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
81' Jose Sanchez blows the whistle, Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Atl. Madrid in a dangerous position.

80' A dangerous towering header by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
80' Alex Baena (Villarreal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
76' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
74' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

72' A precise low pass is received by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Koke leaves the pitch and Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
70' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
68' Substitution. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) in, Thierno Barry out.
68' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denis Suarez (Villarreal) replacing Yeremy Pino.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Gerard Moreno cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' 6:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
63' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
62' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
61' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jose Sanchez who sees an offensive foul.
59' Here is a change. Angel Correa is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
56' Koke (Atl. Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Junior Reis was alert and the score remains the same.
56' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
52' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) will miss the next game.
52' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
52' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.
49' The current number of shots on goal is 4:1.
46' Half-time substitution. Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Samuel Lino.
46' Diego Simeone has made a change at the break. Cesar Azpilicueta has come on in place of Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) comes on the pitch for Conor Gallagher.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) causes Junior Reis little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
45+2' Looks like Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
43' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
42' The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.
41' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
37' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
34' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
32' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jan Oblak to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
29' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

28' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jose Sanchez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Villarreal.
26' Great teamplay by Atl. Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
23' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
22' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' The possession of the ball – 66:34.
18' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
17' Villarreal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
16' The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
13' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Junior Reis easily deals with the threat.

8' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
6' Some neat passing and movement from Atl. Madrid as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
4' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jose Sanchez.
